vendorName: Prime Bearings and Transmission Pvt Ltd
hard: A distributor price list under their own part codes. Read the minimum order column as well as the rate.
A quotation with a make column and a remarks column. The make offered is not always the make asked for, and the lead time is in the remarks.
Prices sit inside paragraphs. Several are for a pack, a carton or a metre, not for one piece, and one has a minimum order.
A photo of a handwritten counter quote. Only some lines are on it, the items are written short, and two rates are for a box.
Two sentences. No price is written. One points at a list price and the other at a quote sent last month.
